text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.title: In-game Console Settings
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.filterL: Show only this log level; choose ALL to show every level.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.filterK: Show only records whose message or exception text contains this keyword; leave empty to disable keyword filtering.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.logReco: Maximum retained raw log entries; defaults to 2147483647. Actual retention is also constrained by the text limit.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.logText: Maximum retained message and exception text in the raw history; defaults to 128 MiB, maximum 2048 MiB. Oldest records are evicted when full.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.autoSpl: Show a display-only overlay when a visible log reaches the trigger level; disable to stop auto splashes.
Visible logs at or above this level trigger an auto splash; choose ALL for any level.
Only visible logs whose message or exception text contains this keyword trigger; leave empty to ignore keywords.
Auto splash overlay height as a percentage of the screen.
How long the overlay stays after the last trigger; another trigger restarts the timer.
Press Esc to close the auto splash overlay; when disabled, Esc goes to the game and the overlay closes after the stay duration.
After closing the overlay with Esc, auto splash stays disabled for this long; 0 disables the silence period.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.errorMe: Color of ERROR and FATAL log messages.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.overlay: View-only overlay height as a percentage of the screen.
Slide-in and slide-out duration of the view-only overlay; 0 disables the animation.
Opacity of the view-only overlay background.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.allowRe: Allow non-host clients to run commands
In a singleplayer world opened to LAN, allow non-host players to run server console commands through this mod; when off, only the host can use them.
text.autoconfig.ingamecnl.option.remoteC: Whitelist: allow when a name or IP matches. Blacklist: deny when a name or IP matches.
Matched against player names, case-insensitively. An empty list grants no non-host player in whitelist mode.
Matched against IP addresses exactly. An empty list grants no non-host player in whitelist mode.
